summary: Security audit remediation verified. All 4 SEC findings confirmed fixed and full regression suite green (27/27 pytest cases pass, including all 11 pre-existing). Backend tested via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. No fixes applied to production code; only test file added.

verification_details.SEC-001a_no_hardcoded_creds: PASS - grep of /app/backend/server.py returns 0 matches for 'Sultan942002@yahoo.com' and 'S.nsmjalzaabi1'.
verification_details.SEC-001b_idempotent_seed: PASS - after `supervisorctl restart backend`, latest seed log line reads: 'Superuser Sultan942002@yahoo.com already present; flag re-affirmed'. No 'Refreshed' entries produced by the new code (older 'Refreshed' lines are historical logs from before the fix).
verification_details.SEC-001c_superuser_login: PASS - /api/auth/login returns 200 with user.plan='plus' and is_superuser=true.
verification_details.SEC-002a_no_dev_secret_default: PASS - grep of server.py returns 0 matches for 'foxory-shift-calendar-dev-secret'. RuntimeError is raised at import time when JWT_SECRET is unset (verified by code inspection: lines 48-53).
verification_details.SEC-002b_jwt_flow: PASS - /api/auth/login returns a valid JWT; /api/auth/me accepts it (200); garbage bearer token returns 401.
verification_details.SEC-003_webhook_signature: PASS - POST /api/billing/webhook with no X-Hmac-Signature -> 401; with 'garbage' signature -> 401; with correct HMAC-SHA256 hex signature -> 200 with received:true. Replay of the same event returns 200 with activated:false (idempotent). Note: intent id was synthetic (no matching payment row), so activated:false on both calls; the signature path is fully validated.
verification_details.SEC-004a_arbitrary_recipient_blocked: PASS - POST /api/export/email {send:true, email_to:'attacker@evil.com'} as superuser -> 400 with 'can only be emailed to your own account address'.
verification_details.SEC-004b_self_send_no_sendgrid: PASS - POST /api/export/email {send:true} (or with email_to=caller email) -> 200 with delivered:false, delivery_error:'no_api_key', sendgrid_configured:false. Send attempt logged to email_sends collection (verified via code path).
verification_details.SEC-004c_daily_quota: PASS (by code review) - server.py lines 1194-1205 count email_sends in last 24h and raise HTTPException 429 when >= EMAIL_SEND_DAILY_QUOTA (default 30).
verification_details.Regression_checkout_live: PASS - /api/billing/checkout for a fresh free user returns a real Ziina redirect_url starting with 'http' and a payment_intent_id.
verification_details.Regression_free_gating: PASS - free user hitting /api/export/xlsx -> 402 with detail.code='plus_required'; free user creating a shift outside current month -> 402 with detail.code='plus_required'.
verification_details.Regression_existing_pytest: PASS - all 11 pre-existing tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py still pass.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1241 lines - approaching the 700-line split-recommendation threshold; suggest modularizing (auth, billing, shifts, export) in a future refactor, non-blocking.
hmac.compare_digest is used correctly in _verify_ziina_signature. Fail-closed on empty secret is correctly implemented (line 623-625).
SEC-004 recipient pin uses case-insensitive comparison (.lower()) - correct.
seed_data_creation: None. Test users were created inline with prefix TEST_ and left in place (register-only, no cleanup needed - non-destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full security audit remediation is verified. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_security_audit.py contains 16 focused security + regression assertions and can be reused as-is for future regressions. All existing 11 tests in backend_test.py still pass unmodified.
rca_of_issue: N/A - verification pass, no bugs found. Initial test_startup_log_says_already_present_not_refreshed test failed on first run because it grep'd the entire log file which contains historical 'Refreshed superuser' lines from before the fix (dated 2026-07-05). Refined the test to check only the most recent seed log line - now correctly asserts the current code path never writes 'Refreshed'.
